name: invoices-cli
description: Render invoice JSON to PDF from the command line.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/bin.ts --target node --minify --outfile dist/bin.js && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp ../../packages/shared/src/assets/fonts/Inter-Regular.ttf ../../packages/shared/src/assets/fonts/Inter-SemiBold.ttf ../../packages/shared/src/assets/fonts/OFL.txt dist/fonts/ && cp ../../LICENSE dist/LICENSE
